description: This file defines the LoggerFactory class within the OrangeHRM framework, responsible for creating and managing logger instances using the Monolog library. It includes methods to retrieve a logger by name, configure handlers, and set logging levels based on the application's debug state.

classes.name: LoggerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and retrieving logger instances with specific configurations, ensuring singleton behavior per logger name.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves an existing logger by name or creates a new one if it does not exist, setting up appropriate handlers and log levels based on the application's debug state.
